description.en: Premium e-commerce platform for traditional and modern Algerian carpets. Arabic-first with full RTL, dual-language (Arabic/French), mobile-optimized. Next.js 16 App Router with Supabase backend, shadcn/ui components, and WhatsApp-native checkout flow.
